title: Invoice 3-Way Match Automation

rationale.conversation_quality: Rules, systems, and exceptions are documented.
rationale.build_readiness: ERP write access is the remaining open dependency.

systems.name: AP Mailbox
systems.access_path: Microsoft Graph API scoped to one mailbox

rules.name: Three-way match
rules.logic: Invoice, purchase order, and goods receipt must agree.

open_items.consequence_if_different: Agent creates posting proposals instead of postings.

chapters.title: About this document
chapters.body: Confirmed automation framework generated from reviewed conversations.

body.summary: Automate the confirmed standard Invoice 3-Way Match case while exceptions remain human-controlled.

body.problem: Analysts manually compare invoices, purchase orders, and goods receipts.

body.description: Share of invoices checked fully automatically.
Hours spent only on exceptions and approvals.

chapters.title: The solution and the to-be process

body.solution: Read invoice and ERP data, apply confirmed matching rules, and queue exceptions for human review.

chapters.title: How it is built - systems, data flow, integration

body.access: Microsoft Graph API scoped to one mailbox with change notifications and delta sync
REST API with OAuth client credentials and a sandbox
Runs in the tenant boundary in the EU region only
Suite web app with SSO to the identity provider

body.commercialNote: Postings above EUR 5,000 stay behind a gated write path.

chapters.title: What we need from the client

body.detail: Microsoft Graph API, strictly limited to the one AP mailbox
REST API for purchase orders, goods receipts, and posted documents
Posting of payment documents via API remains an open IT dependency
SSO connection of the Approval App to the identity provider

body.people: Business: Sandra in AP. Technical: IT lead.

body.guardrail: Processing and storage stay in the EU only.
Agent uses a least-privilege technical user; mailbox access is limited to the AP mailbox.
Every decision is logged with invoice, rule, result, and any human approver.

body.control: All exceptions are decided by people; a kill switch returns to the current process.

body.limit: Postings above EUR 5,000 require human approval.

body.question: Is ERP write access formally approved before build week 2?

body.assumption: Extraction confidence at or above 0.9 is treated as reliable.
Discount agreements are queryable in the ERP.

body.checklist: Business confirmation of the captured process is done.
Technical validation of access and controls is done.

body.step: Formally approve ERP write access before build week 2.
Go decision in Deployment Control using this report.
